text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
At the end of their treasure hunt, {0} and Tamaki
are resting on the beach, laughing and gazing at the stars.
text_block_list.orig_text:
宝探しを終えた後、{0}とタマキは
きれいな星空を見ながら浜辺で談笑していた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It's like the whole sky is raining down!
text_block_list.orig_text: 星が降ってきてるみたいにゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe there was such a purr-fect view
waiting at the end of that nyasty cave...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの怖い洞窟の先に、
こんなきれいな景色が広がってたにゃんて……

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Hey... You two over there.
It's dangerous to wander around these parts at night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
そこの君たち、
この時間にそんなところにいると危ないよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Oh, is this old guy on patrol?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
あ、
見回りの警備員さんかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: After all that time in the dark, the lantern's blinding my eyes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずっと暗い場所にいたから、
ランタンが眩しいにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: In fact... The lantern light's getting brighter and brighter...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか、
ランタンの光が
どんどん大きくなってにゃい？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I can't keep my eyes open!
text_block_list.orig_text:
目を、
開けてられないにゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Thanks for coming to help me out with the beach cafe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！　
一緒に海の家の手伝いに来てくれて助かるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm only here myself 'cause a friend asked me to help out.
But I heard there's a special bonus for the cafes that make
the most profits!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも先輩に頼まれて応援に呼ばれた身なんだけど、
売上げ上位の海の家には
ボーナスが支給されるって聞いて……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
So I figured if you help me out,
we might be able to aim for the number one spot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}に手伝ってもらえたら、
売上げ一位も夢じゃないと思って頼んだにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow! Let's sell and sell and sell some more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
売って売って売りさばくにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... I think this cafe's menu is too ordinary right nyow.
We need to come up with some new items.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
この海の家のメニューはオーソドックスな気がするにゃ。
これはメニューを増やすべきにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You know what that means!
Let's add my specialty, taiyaki, to the lineup!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはやっぱり
あたし一押し、
たい焼きを加えるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: We're all ready! Let's open up shop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備ＯＫ！　
お店を開店するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Something's wrong. Nobody's buying the taiyaki I made.
Don't they appreciate my golden ratio of outer cake and
sweet bean filling?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おかしい。
たい焼きの売れ行きがさっぱりにゃ。
このあんこと皮の黄金比率の何がいけないにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Look, this cafe's selling taiyaki!
Talk about out-of-season!
Who wants to eat taiyaki at the beach?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この海の家、たい焼き売ってる～
季節感ゼロだね～　
夏の海に来てたい焼きとか拷問でしょ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh... I don't want to accept it, but... It's true...
Steaming hot taiyaki isn't a great match for the summer heat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐうぅっ……
認めたくないけど……
確かに
暑い夏にたい焼きはちょっとミスマッチな気がするにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But there's no point selling the same stuff as everyone else!
Isn't there anything we can use to make our cafe stand out?!
choice_data_list: Why limit ourselves to existing recipes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
他と同じものを売ってても意味がない気がするにゃ！
この海の家だからこそ味わえる、
そんな料理はないにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! That does sound like fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉっ！　
それは面白そうにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right!
There's nyo rule against thinking outside the box a little!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
確かに！　
型にとらわれない料理だってかまわないはずにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
All righty then! Let's come up with a tasty snack
that'll take this beach by storm!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ早速、
みんなの度肝を抜くスイーツを開発するにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Personally, I'd like to make something with a nyice catty theme...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりあたしは、
猫に関係のあるスイーツを推していきたいにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: And if possible, I don't want to give up on the taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
たい焼きはやっぱり外したくないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But... Steaming hot taiyaki on a hot summer's day
just sounds like some kind of punishment...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
暑い夏にほかほかの熱いあんこのたい焼きは、
ちょっと罰ゲームな気がするにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I just had an idea!
What if we went for a salty taste instead?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで
あたしは考えたにゃ！
　
しょっぱい味ならいけるんじゃないかって！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Taiyaki you can eat as a savory snack, like a rice ball!
I call it... Mackerel-Stuffed Taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにぎりのように軽食感覚で食べられるたい焼き！
名付けて、
『サバ缶入りたい焼き』！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This'll set any cat purring! The customers'll be all over it!
Go on, give it a taste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これなら猫まっしぐら、
お客さんもまっしぐらにゃ！
いざ、
ご賞味あれにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Humanity isn't ready for this flavor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
ちょっと人類には早過ぎる味にゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... I guess humans won't go for the same bait as cats...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
猫まっしぐらでも人には合わないかもにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: F-fine then! Time for Plan B!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それなら次の案にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Summer treats have gotta be cold!
And what's colder than shaved ice?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり夏と言えば冷たいもの！
冷たいものと言えばかき氷！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: However... Shaved ice is usually a sweet treat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
かき氷もやっぱり甘いものが主流……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd mix things up with a flavor everyone in Japan knyows!
A dash of soy sauce and fish flakes...
It's my \"Kitty-Rice-Style Shaved Ice\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこで、
より香り高く、
日本人の慣れ親しんだ味、
醤油とかつお節で仕立てた
『ねこまんまかき氷』！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This dish varies a lot depending on the region,
so I thought I'd let the customers season it themselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
地域によっては
調味料や具材も変わるから、
そこはセルフで試してもらおうと思うにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This one's a winner! It'll sell like hotcakes!
When I tasted it, the delicious flavor blew me away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは自信作にゃ！　
絶対売れるにゃ！
味見したら
あまりのおいしさにびっくりしたにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myah? Why're you going pale just looking at it?
\"It might be to some people's tastes, but the color's no good\"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃ？　
なんで食べる前から青白い顔してるにゃ……
味の好みは分かれるかもだが、
色がいまいち……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! It looks all brown and muddy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
確かに！　
全体的に茶色くて地味にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: But... But...! I want to share my catty tastes with everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
でも……！　
あたしは猫っぽい個性を打ち出したいにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I need a flavor that'll stick in everyone's hearts,
making this kitty cafe a memory they'll hold onto forever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この海の家が、忘れられなくなるような、
美味しくて
猫を連想させるスイーツを作りたいにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Let's go back to basics and make the taiyaki work?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ここは初心に帰って、
たい焼きを使うって……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But we already tried taiyaki! Nyobody wants it!
Steaming-hot taiyaki and summer don't mix!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
たい焼きはさっぱり売れなかったにゃ！
ホカホカのたい焼きは夏には不向きにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Oh, b-but... If we combined it with something cold...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
で、
でも、
冷たいのと合わせれば……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If we could create a sweet treat
that uses hot and cold together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
熱いと冷たいを同時に味わえる、
そんなスイーツにできれば……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
After all, the traditional Uji-Kintoki uses bean paste!
So actually, it's a great match for shaved ice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそも
宇治金時はあんこを使ってるにゃ！
てことは、
かき氷とあんこの相性はいいはずにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'll serve shaved ice with taiyaki on top...!
It's a simple idea, but it has a totally unique impact!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうにゃ！　
かき氷の上にたい焼きを乗せれば……！
シンプルだけど、
個性的なスイーツの完成にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
And the flavors match!
Taiyaki and shaved ice—a harmony of hot and cold!
The sweet taste of bean paste will wash away the summer sweat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
味もいける！　
たい焼きと氷の温度差による絶妙なハーモニー！
夏の暑さを紛らわせる
さわやかなあんこの甘さも素晴らしいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna add it to the menu right nyow!
text_block_list.orig_text: さっそくこれをメニューに出すにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I want a Taiyaki Shaved Ice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん！　
たい焼きかき氷くださーい！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Can I get two of them, please?!
text_block_list.orig_text: こっちは二つお願いしまーす！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Coming right up, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text: ただいまお作りしますにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! It's a total hit!
Let's keep up this momentum right to the end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいにゃー！　
大盛況にゃー！　
このまま終日まで突っ走るにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Still, it's great that we're busy, but the weather's so hot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
忙しいのはいいけど天気が良くて暑いにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: This [i]is[/i] a beach cafe, so I'll work in my swimsuit!
choice_data_list: That'll help our popularity for sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の家だし、
水着姿で接客するにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hm? You think it'll attract more customers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
この姿で集客率アップが望めるにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Then I guess I'll stick with this look!
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ終わるまでこの格好で過ごすにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: H-huhhhh?! What're you saying?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ～！？　
なに言ってるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I could take off...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
もうちょっとくらいなら……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Wait, nyo time for talking! The customers are lining up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
そんなこと言ってるうちに行列が出来てるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Look—even the normal taiyaki is starting to sell!
We need to make more, and quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも
普通のたい焼きも売れてきてるにゃ！
もっともっとたい焼きを作るにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This is the final day of the profits contest!
Lately the customers have even started cheering us on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日で売上げ勝負最終日にゃ～
浜辺にいる人たちにたくさん声をかけられるようになったにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Feels like these last few days went by in a flash...
text_block_list.orig_text: あっという間の数日間だったにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow, how did we do in the cafe rankings?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
この店の売上げは何位かにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: The beach cafe with the top sales this summer is...Miss Tamaki's Kitty Treats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年度の
売上げナンバーワン海の家は、
たまきさんの海の家です！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
W-we did it! It's all thanks to your advice, {0}!
This was the best summer ever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やったにゃ～！　
{0}のアドバイスのおかげにゃ！
最高の夏の思い出にゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And... welcome back!
Congrats on the cafe's big success!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れ様～！　
売上げ一位
おめでと～！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Was that all a dream, you ask?
Well, something like that, yes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のは夢かって？　
まぁ、夢みたいなものね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: But trust me, the victory you won is real.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
二人で掴みとった勝利は本物よ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, until next time. I'll see you again soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあまた会いましょう。
そう遠くないうちに。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Unhhhh... What was that weird dream...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
今の夢は一体……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh? You just had a funny dream too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
{0}も夢を見てたにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Still, I gotta say, selling mountains of taiyaki even in my dreams?
I really am the top cat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
夢の中までたい焼きを売ってるなんて
さすがあたしだにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyow, I guess this is the end of our little adventure!
Tomorrow I need to get back to selling my wares,
so let's head home for today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
これで冒険の時間もおしまいにゃ！
明日からまたバリバリたい焼きを売っていくから
今日はもう帰るのにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Tamaki skipped off along the beach
with a new spring in her step.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言い残し、足取り軽く
浜辺を去っていくタマキだった。
